caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected at full canvas size; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large editorial promise names a platform-and-year context, followed by a short four-step subhead.
visual_anatomy.layout: Four unequal but balanced panels sit in a two-by-two board: a stack-and-bullets module, an 80/20 partition, an action list, and a stepped blueprint with small relationship labels.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline → top-left and top-right action panels → bottom-left and bottom-right panels, with each numbered panel readable as an independent contribution to one plan.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large high-contrast editorial title paired with bold sans panel titles, numbered badges, and compact action labels.
visual_anatomy.colour: Pale blue, green, yellow, and lavender identify the four numbered panels; each colour carries into its miniature diagram or accent labels.
visual_anatomy.surface: White ground, thin coloured panel outlines, pale flat fills, simple 3D stack shapes, rounded chips, and restrained shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Four numbered action panels, each using a different visual grammar matched to its message: stack, partition, checklist, or stepped plan.
visual_anatomy.density: High but chunked: four strong panel identities stop the board from becoming one dense instructional sheet.

motion.observed_state_change: The start and material-intermediate samples retain the same four-panel information board; the near-complete sample catches a broad loop-transition wipe through the board. A change in any action state cannot be established from the samples.
motion.motion_job: Attention pacing and loop reset, not a demonstrated change in the four-part plan.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Absorb several distinct actions as one compact plan without forcing every action into the same visual form.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Four-part action board with heterogeneous micro-diagrams.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Give each action one dedicated panel and a matching miniature representation, then preserve a common title, number, and border system for orientation.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when there are four deliberately distinct but equally necessary actions; avoid it when there is a real sequential dependency that needs a process route instead.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s platform/year promise, algorithm claims, four action categories, stack/80-20/blueprint diagrams, colour assignment, title treatment, or loop transition.

claim_boundary.note: The asset contains platform, algorithm, and tactical assertions. The supplied corpus does not independently verify them or the asserted caption association.
